   124→-- Add authoring-space triangle mesh (v_list: { {x,y,z}, ... }, f_list: 1-based { {a,b,c}, ... })
   125→function MeshBin:addRaw(key, v_list, f_list, hardCrease, uvScale)
   126→	local b = self:getBucket(key)
   127→	uvScale = uvScale or 12.0
   128→	if hardCrease then
   129→		for _, tri in ipairs(f_list) do
   130→			local p1, p2, p3 = v_list[tri[1]], v_list[tri[2]], v_list[tri[3]]
   131→			local s1 = toStudioPos(p1[1], p1[2], p1[3])
   132→			local s2 = toStudioPos(p2[1], p2[2], p2[3])
   133→			local s3 = toStudioPos(p3[1], p3[2], p3[3])
   134→			local cr = (s2 - s1):Cross(s3 - s1)
   135→			if cr.Magnitude > 1e-7 then
   136→				local nrm = cr.Unit
   137→				local base = #b.vs
   138→				b.vs[base + 1] = s1; b.vs[base + 2] = s2; b.vs[base + 3] = s3
   139→				b.ns[base + 1] = nrm; b.ns[base + 2] = nrm; b.ns[base + 3] = nrm
   140→				b.uvs[base + 1] = Vector2.new((p1[1] + p1[2] * 0.5) / uvScale, (p1[3] + p1[2] * 0.3) / uvScale)
   141→				b.uvs[base + 2] = Vector2.new((p2[1] + p2[2] * 0.5) / uvScale, (p2[3] + p2[2] * 0.3) / uvScale)
   142→				b.uvs[base + 3] = Vector2.new((p3[1] + p3[2] * 0.5) / uvScale, (p3[3] + p3[2] * 0.3) / uvScale)
   143→				b.fs[#b.fs + 1] = {base + 1, base + 2, base + 3}
   144→			end
   145→		end
   146→	else
   147→		local base = #b.vs
   148→		local accN = table.create(#v_list, Vector3.zero)
   149→		local stV = table.create(#v_list)
   150→		for i, p in ipairs(v_list) do
   151→			stV[i] = toStudioPos(p[1], p[2], p[3])
   152→		end
   153→		for _, tri in ipairs(f_list) do
   154→			local i1, i2, i3 = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
   155→			local cr = (stV[i2] - stV[i1]):Cross(stV[i3] - stV[i1])
   156→			if cr.Magnitude > 1e-7 then
   157→				accN[i1] += cr; accN[i2] += cr; accN[i3] += cr
   158→				b.fs[#b.fs + 1] = {base + i1, base + i2, base + i3}
   159→			end
   160→		end
   161→		for i, p in ipairs(v_list) do
   162→			b.vs[base + i] = stV[i]
   163→			local nm = accN[i]
   164→			b.ns[base + i] = nm.Magnitude > 1e-7 and nm.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
   165→			b.uvs[base + i] = Vector2.new((p[1] + 25.0) / uvScale, (p[3] + 22.0) / uvScale)
   166→		end
   167→	end
   168→end

   170→function MeshBin:box(key, cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz, rotCF_src)

   174→		{-hx, -hy,  hz}, { hx, -hy,  hz}, { hx,  hy,  hz}, {-hx,  hy,  hz},
   175→	}
   176→	local vs = {}

   178→		if rotCF_src then
   179→			local p = rotCF_src:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(c[1], c[2], c[3]))
   180→			vs[i] = {cx + p.X, cy + p.Y, cz + p.Z}
   181→		else
   182→			vs[i] = {cx + c[1], cy + c[2], cz + c[3]}
   183→		end
   184→	end
   185→	local fs = {
   186→		{1, 3, 2}, {1, 4, 3}, {5, 6, 7}, {5, 7, 8},
   187→		{1, 2, 6}, {1, 6, 5}, {2, 3, 7}, {2, 7, 6},

   193→function MeshBin:quad(key, pts)
   194→	-- Extrude into a 0.036-stud 3D closed relief plate (ZERO coplanar 0-thickness back-to-back triangles!)
   195→	local p1 = Vector3.new(pts[1][1], pts[1][2], pts[1][3])
   196→	local p2 = Vector3.new(pts[2][1], pts[2][2], pts[2][3])
   197→	local p3 = Vector3.new(pts[3][1], pts[3][2], pts[3][3])
   198→	local p4 = Vector3.new(pts[4][1], pts[4][2], pts[4][3])
   199→	local cr = (p2 - p1):Cross(p3 - p1)
   200→	local n = cr.Magnitude > 1e-6 and cr.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
   201→	local h = n * 0.018
   202→	local vs = {
   203→		{p1.X + h.X, p1.Y + h.Y, p1.Z + h.Z},
   204→		{p2.X + h.X, p2.Y + h.Y, p2.Z + h.Z},
   205→		{p3.X + h.X, p3.Y + h.Y, p3.Z + h.Z},
   206→		{p4.X + h.X, p4.Y + h.Y, p4.Z + h.Z},
   207→		{p1.X - h.X, p1.Y - h.Y, p1.Z - h.Z},
   208→		{p2.X - h.X, p2.Y - h.Y, p2.Z - h.Z},
   209→		{p3.X - h.X, p3.Y - h.Y, p3.Z - h.Z},
   210→		{p4.X - h.X, p4.Y - h.Y, p4.Z - h.Z},
   211→	}
   212→	-- Verify winding in Studio space against centroid so every face points strictly outward
   213→	local cSt = Vector3.zero
   214→	for i = 1, 8 do cSt += toStudioPos(vs[i][1], vs[i][2], vs[i][3]) end
   215→	cSt /= 8
   216→	local rawFs = {
   217→		{1, 2, 3}, {1, 3, 4},
   218→		{5, 7, 6}, {5, 8, 7},
   219→		{1, 5, 6}, {1, 6, 2},
   220→		{2, 6, 7}, {2, 7, 3},
   221→		{3, 7, 8}, {3, 8, 4},
   222→		{4, 8, 5}, {4, 5, 1},
   223→	}
   224→	local fs = {}
   225→	for _, tr in ipairs(rawFs) do
   226→		local s1 = toStudioPos(vs[tr[1]][1], vs[tr[1]][2], vs[tr[1]][3])
   227→		local s2 = toStudioPos(vs[tr[2]][1], vs[tr[2]][2], vs[tr[2]][3])
   228→		local s3 = toStudioPos(vs[tr[3]][1], vs[tr[3]][2], vs[tr[3]][3])
   229→		local fn = (s2 - s1):Cross(s3 - s1)
   230→		local fc = (s1 + s2 + s3) / 3
   231→		if fn:Dot(fc - cSt) >= 0 then
   232→			fs[#fs + 1] = {tr[1], tr[2], tr[3]}
   233→		else
   234→			fs[#fs + 1] = {tr[1], tr[3], tr[2]}
   235→		end
   236→	end
   237→	self:addRaw(key, vs, fs, true, 8.0)
   238→end

   240→function MeshBin:cyl(key, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, r, segs, hard)
   241→	local dx, dy, dz = bx - ax, by - ay, bz - az
   242→	local L = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
   243→	if L < 1e-4 then return end
   244→	local fwd = Vector3.new(dx / L, dy / L, dz / L)
   245→	local ref = math.abs(fwd.Z) < 0.92 and Vector3.zAxis or Vector3.xAxis
   246→	local uAx = fwd:Cross(ref).Unit
   247→	local vAx = fwd:Cross(uAx).Unit
   248→	local vs, fs = {}, {}
   249→	for ring = 0, 1 do
   250→		local ox = ring == 0 and ax or bx
   251→		local oy = ring == 0 and ay or by
   252→		local oz = ring == 0 and az or bz
   253→		for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   254→			local th = 2 * math.pi * j / segs
   255→			local ct, st = math.cos(th) * r, math.sin(th) * r
   256→			local p = uAx * ct + vAx * st
   257→			vs[#vs + 1] = {ox + p.X, oy + p.Y, oz + p.Z}
   258→		end
   259→	end
   260→	local c0 = #vs + 1; vs[c0] = {ax, ay, az}
   261→	local c1 = #vs + 1; vs[c1] = {bx, by, bz}
   262→	for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   263→		local k = (j + 1) % segs
   264→		local a, b, c, d = j + 1, k + 1, segs + j + 1, segs + k + 1
   265→		fs[#fs + 1] = {a, b, d}; fs[#fs + 1] = {a, d, c}
   266→	end
   267→	self:addRaw(key, vs, fs, hard == true, 8.0)
   268→	-- Flat endcaps with crisp rim normals
   269→	local cap0, cap1, cf0, cf1 = {{ax, ay, az}}, {{bx, by, bz}}, {}, {}
   270→	for j = 1, segs do
   271→		cap0[j + 1] = vs[j]
   272→		cap1[j + 1] = vs[segs + j]
   273→	end
   274→	for j = 1, segs do
   275→		local k = (j % segs) + 1
   276→		cf0[#cf0 + 1] = {1, k + 1, j + 1}
   277→		cf1[#cf1 + 1] = {1, j + 1, k + 1}
   278→	end
   279→	self:addRaw(key, cap0, cf0, true, 8.0)
   280→	self:addRaw(key, cap1, cf1, true, 8.0)
   281→end

   283→-- CNC 64-seg ring along Y_src around (cx, *, cz): smooth radial curvature + razor-sharp rim edges!
   284→function MeshBin:annulus(key, y0, y1, r_in0, r_out0, r_in1, r_out1, segs, cx, cz)
   285→	r_in1 = r_in1 or r_in0
   286→	r_out1 = r_out1 or r_out0
   287→	cx = cx or FAN_X; cz = cz or FAN_Z
   288→	local specs = {
   289→		{y0, r_in0, y0, r_out0, false, true},
   290→		{y1, r_in1, y1, r_out1, true,  true},
   291→		{y0, r_in0, y1, r_in1,  true,  false},
   292→		{y0, r_out0,y1, r_out1, false, false},
   293→	}
   294→	for _, sp in ipairs(specs) do
   295→		local ya, ra, yb, rb, flip, isFlat = sp[1], sp[2], sp[3], sp[4], sp[5], sp[6]
   296→		if math.abs(ya - yb) > 1e-5 or math.abs(ra - rb) > 1e-5 then
   297→			local vs, fs = {}, {}
   298→			for ring = 0, 1 do
   299→				local yv = ring == 0 and ya or yb
   300→				local rv = ring == 0 and ra or rb
   301→				for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   302→					local th = 2 * math.pi * j / segs
   303→					vs[#vs + 1] = {cx + rv * math.cos(th), yv, cz + rv * math.sin(th)}
   304→				end
   305→			end
   306→			for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   307→				local k = (j + 1) % segs
   308→				local aa, bb, cc, dd = j + 1, k + 1, segs + j + 1, segs + k + 1
   309→				if flip then
   310→					fs[#fs + 1] = {aa, bb, cc}; fs[#fs + 1] = {bb, dd, cc}
   311→				else
   312→					fs[#fs + 1] = {aa, cc, bb}; fs[#fs + 1] = {bb, cc, dd}
   313→				end
   314→			end
   315→			self:addRaw(key, vs, fs, isFlat, 8.0)
   316→		end
   317→	end
   318→end

   320→function MeshBin:emitToModel(parentModel, namePrefix, collide)
   321→	local jobs = {}
   322→	for key, b in pairs(self.buckets) do
   323→		if #b.fs > 0 then
   324→			jobs[#jobs + 1] = {key = key, b = b}
   325→		end
   326→	end
   327→	local BATCH = 10
   328→	local idx = 1
   329→	while idx <= #jobs do
   330→		local batchEnd = math.min(#jobs, idx + BATCH - 1)
   331→		local remaining = batchEnd - idx + 1
   332→		local caller = coroutine.running()
   333→		local resumed = false
   334→		for j = idx, batchEnd do
   335→			local item = jobs[j]
   336→			task.spawn(function()
   337→				local okRun, errRun = pcall(function()
   338→					local key, b = item.key, item.b
   339→					local minX, minY, minZ = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge
   340→					local maxX, maxY, maxZ = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
   341→					for _, v in ipairs(b.vs) do
   342→						if v.X < minX then minX = v.X end; if v.X > maxX then maxX = v.X end
   343→						if v.Y < minY then minY = v.Y end; if v.Y > maxY then maxY = v.Y end
   344→						if v.Z < minZ then minZ = v.Z end; if v.Z > maxZ then maxZ = v.Z end
   345→					end
   346→					local center = Vector3.new((minX + maxX) * 0.5, (minY + maxY) * 0.5, (minZ + maxZ) * 0.5)
   347→					local em = AssetService:CreateEditableMesh()
   348→					local vids = table.create(#b.vs)
   349→					local nids = table.create(#b.vs)
   350→					local uvids = table.create(#b.vs)
   351→					for i = 1, #b.vs do
   352→						vids[i] = em:AddVertex(b.vs[i] - center)
   353→						nids[i] = em:AddNormal(b.ns[i])
   354→						uvids[i] = em:AddUV(b.uvs[i])
   355→					end
   356→					for _, tri in ipairs(b.fs) do
   357→						local i1, i2, i3 = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
   358→						local fid = em:AddTriangle(vids[i1], vids[i2], vids[i3])
   359→						em:SetFaceNormals(fid, {nids[i1], nids[i2], nids[i3]})
   360→						em:SetFaceUVs(fid, {uvids[i1], uvids[i2], uvids[i3]})
   361→					end
   362→					local ok, st, content = pcall(function()
   363→						return AssetService:CreateDataModelContentAsync(Content.fromObject(em))
   364→					end)
   365→					local mp
   366→					if ok and st == Enum.CreateContentResult.Success and content then
   367→						pcall(function() em:Destroy() end)
